title: DeFinite1
tagline: DeFinite1: A non-custodial, multi-chain treasury dashboard for DAOs, startups & DeFi pros.
description: DeFinite1 is a powerful, non-custodial treasury management platform built for DAOs, DeFi-native teams and crypto treasuries seeking control, automation and cross-chain agility and that too without compromising security. It unifies multi-chain portfolio tracking, optimized token swaps and seamless cross-chain transfers through deep integration with 1inch’s powerful suite of APIs including Fusion and Fusion+. DeFinite1 offers MEV-protected transactions, gasless swaps, and real-time portfolio insights across various EVM networks. Whether rebalancing assets or simulating trades DeFinite1 acts as your intelligent command center, allowing you to manage treasury workflows with precision, speed and peace of mind and all of these while staying fully self-custodial.
how_its_made:
Under the hood, DeFinite1 is a Next.js single-page app, talking directly to a suite of 1inch REST APIs and a lightweight Next API layer that glues everything together:

Frontend (Next.js + Tailwind + Wagmi/RainbowKit):
- Wallet integration via Wagmi/RainbowKit for smooth MetaMask, WalletConnect, etc. onboarding
- Beautiful UI using TailwindCSS and ShadCN.

Backend/API (Next.js API Routes + Node):
- 1inch Balance, Spot Price and Portfolio APIs portfolio snapshots across 12 EVM chains
- Swap & Fusion APIs to fetch quotes, route splits and submit intent-based, gasless orders through resolvers
- Fusion+ API to coordinate trustless, atomic cross-chain swaps with hashlocks and timelocks

Partner Technologies & Security:
- 1inch APIs like Token API, Portfolio API, Fusion & Fusion+ APIs are used to make this project happen.

Hacky Bits Worth Mentioning:
- Not as such but we aggregated bunch of APIs and tried to make something great out of it, in this way we prevented DeFinite1 from becoming another DEX or Bridge App.
